data.text/markdown: Find a set of control variables that close/block all backdoor paths. Block the pipe ||(X \perp\!\!\!\perp U \mid Z||) ||[ p(Y | do(X)) = \sum_z p(Y \mid X, Z)P(Z = z) \\[2em] Y_i \sim \text{Normal}(\mu_i, \sigma) \\ \mu_i=\alpha+\beta_XX_i + \beta_ZZ_i ||]||[ \\[2em] \begin{aligned} U &\sim \text{Bernoulli}(0.5) \\ Z &\sim \text{Normal}(\beta_{UZ}U, 1) \\ X &\sim \text{Normal}(\beta_{ZX}Z, 1) \\ Y &\sim \text{Normal}(\alpha + \beta_{XY}X + \beta_{UY}U, 1) \\ \end{aligned} ||]Note the ols command is close to this ||(Y = \alpha + \text{coef}X + \text{coef}Z + \epsilon||) Unstratified / confounded Note exponential is a > 0 value with mean 1 and we are using priors too ||[ \\[2em] \begin{aligned} \alpha &\sim \text{Normal}(0, 1) \\ \beta_{XY} &\sim \text{Normal}(0, 1) \\ \sigma_Y &\sim {\text{Exponential}(1)} \\ \mu &= \alpha + \beta_{XY}X \\ Y &\sim \text{Normal}(\mu, \sigma_Y) \\ \end{aligned} ||]Stratified / confounded ||[ \begin{aligned} Y &\sim \text{Normal}(\mu_Y, \sigma_Y) \\ \mu_Y &= \alpha + \beta_{XY}X + \beta_{Z}Z \\ \alpha &\sim \text{Normal}(0, 1) \\ \beta_{XY} &\sim \text{Normal}(0, 1) \\ \beta_{Z} &\sim \text{Normal}(0, 1) \\ \sigma_Y &\sim \text{Exponential}(1) \\ \end{aligned} ||]
